gloss: to face; to tackle; to be present at

definitions.gloss: to face; to tackle; to be present at (an occasion)
definitions.explanation: To face an event, challenge, or formal occasion, often with a sense of readiness or resolve. Used for competitions, exams, ceremonies, or any important occasion one is about to participate in.

definitions.gloss: to face; to overlook (a view or location)
definitions.explanation: Of a building, room, or location: to face onto or overlook something such as the sea, a plaza, or a mountain. Used in formal or descriptive writing.

notes:
Formal verb used in written and public speech. Common in sports commentary, ceremony language, and descriptive writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{望|のぞ}む→望む：01976_nozomu⟧ (01976): to wish; to desire; to hope for — a frequent homophone with a completely different meaning; note 望 vs 臨 in kanji
- ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to face; to head toward (less formal, more directional movement)
- ⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧: to challenge; to take on (implies active defiance)
